card.name: Inside long drug and medical words
card.fires_on: Partway through a long drug or medical term, just before the rest of the word, e.g. 'd' in dapsone, 'ips' in antipsychotics, 'iot' in angiotensin. It is strongest in drug-interaction text.

modes.label: Split drug names
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a drug or drug class name, where the rest of the word is still to come.

modes.label: Split medical terms
modes.description: A piece inside a long clinical term or abbreviation such as COPD or corticosteroid.
